description: This file defines a PHP trait named NormalizerTrait used within the OrangeHRM system to provide normalization functionalities for model objects. The trait includes methods for setting and retrieving model class and data, normalizing single objects or arrays of objects, and ensuring models implement necessary interfaces.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Retrieves the current model class name.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data associated with the normalizer.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a single object, converting it to an array representation.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array or iterable of objects, converting each to an array representation.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Validates that the model class implements the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the model class, initializing with data.
